title: The direct-read health check answers 'all fine' when it cannot read its own record
what: The page the nightly watch reads to learn whether the direct-read record is failing answers 'working, not failing' whenever HQ cannot read the note where it keeps the failure start time. A broken store therefore hides a real failure: no warning on HQ and no email from the watch.
expected: When the check cannot read its own record it should answer 'could not check', so the watch warns instead of staying quiet.
how_often: only when the store holding the health note fails
fix_line: Answer 'unknown' instead of 'fine' when the health note cannot be read, and let the watch treat unknown as a warning

title: AI prices, the rupee rate and the India-day rule are copied by hand in several HQ files
what: HQ keeps two separate AI price lists and two copies of the dollar-to-rupee rate (one for the System and gym pages, one for the English helper), the first copied by hand from the gym server's own list. The 'today in India' rule is written five separate times. Today they agree, but a price or rule changed in one place will leave HQ showing a different AI cost or day from the rest of the product.
expected: One shared price list, one rupee rate and one India-day rule that every HQ part uses.
how_often: whenever a price or rate changes
fix_line: Keep one price list, rate and India-day helper and import it everywhere

title: Nine HQ database tests skip themselves quietly if the test machine lacks the database part
what: Nine of HQ's main tests (AI use and cost, messages, nightly clean-up, replies, AI limits) are told to skip, not fail, when the built-in database part is missing, and their note still says the cloud check has no such part. Other HQ test files need the same part and would fail loudly, so today they run, but a change of test machine could turn these nine into silent passes with a green check.
expected: A missing database part fails the run, and the stale note is removed.
how_often: only if the test machine changes
fix_line: Drop the skip so a missing database part fails the run, and fix the note
